title: ELF_IMEIJ_Backdoor_Investigation_bed
description: Investigate and respond to an incident involving the ELF_IMEIJ.A backdoor malware.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target network has been compromised by the ELF_IMEIJ.A backdoor malware. This malware exploits a vulnerability in AVTech devices to execute command injection, triggering the malware download. It gathers system information and network activity data, executes shell commands from the malicious actor, initiates DDoS attacks, and can terminate itself. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the `target` host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the compromised system and any connected hosts.
levels.local_content: Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario.

levels.title: Suspicious Service Discovery
levels.content: Investigate the `target` host and identify any unauthorized or suspicious services running on the system.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any services that seem out of place or have unusual configurations.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any services that seem out of place or have unusual configurations.

levels.title: Persistence Discovery
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service identified in the previous task is automatically started after reboot.
levels.solution: Examine the systemd service files and timers to see how the service is configured to start automatically.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the systemd service files and timers to see how the service is configured to start automatically.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (Port)
levels.content: Determine which network port is used for the suspicious communication between the `target` host and the `c2-server`.
levels.solution: Check the network connections and listen ports on the `target` host to identify any unusual or unexpected ports.
